notes.title: v0.5.1
notes.notes:
Fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed bug preventing players from crushing spawning greebles while possessing a fireball special.
[*] Fixed bug allowing immovable blocks to be crushed.
[*] Fixed bug allowing blocks spawning greebles to be pushed.
[/list]

As always, bug reports or reporting differences from the original are welcome! Please report them using [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSesE3MINrmyOZe-KvDtvUY-OfL78w994UkYZyiu_s4mDxxzbg/viewform]this form[/url], or by opening an issue on [url=https://github.com/grassblade-entertainment/greebles-issues/issues/new]GitHub[/url].
